invariants.rationale: Method logic uses 'element' heavily and assumes non-null value.
parentLayers.add(layer) is called; parentLayers is expected to be non-null at method exit.
map is used in y adjustment (e.g., mapHeightInPixels possibly from map fields).
tmxFile is required for handle computation and image resolution if an image layer is loaded.
imageResolver.getImage(...) is called to resolve the texture; imageResolver must be non-null.
